@@ -192,7 +192,7 @@ The **Promotions** folder in user mailboxes has the following characteristics:

englishSummary.headline: Bulk-mail guidance now includes Outlook for Mac
englishSummary.summary: The behavior matrix adds Outlook for Mac and indicates that bulk mail below the BCL threshold can be delivered to the Promotions folder there. It also states that deleting the folder permanently causes it to be recreated within a few minutes.
englishSummary.adminImpact: No administrator action is stated. Consider this behavior when supporting Mac users or troubleshooting bulk-mail delivery.
